people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Moreover the king’s servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne;’ and the king bowed himself on the bed.
translations.bsb: The king’s servants have also gone to congratulate our lord King David, saying, ‘May your God make the name of Solomon more famous than your own name, and may He make his throne greater than your throne.’ And the king has bowed in worship on his bed,
translations.kjv: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make ➔ his throne greater than thy throne. And the king bowed himself upon the bed.
translations.asv: And moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king David, saying, Thy God make the name of Solomon better than thy name, and make his throne greater than thy throne: and the king bowed himself upon the bed.
